name: CSO_USER_KEY_VALUES
description: Contains key/value pairs for the user.

columns.name: DATE_ADDED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was added to the repository.

columns.name: DATE_MODIFIED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was modified.

columns.name: KEY_ID
columns.description: This is the key id given to this record.

columns.name: VALUE
columns.description: This is the value for the record.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: This is the obsolete GUID of the user for this record.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the ID of the user for this record.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_MIGRATED_FLAG
columns.description: This is the flag which maintains if user's follow document values have been migrated.
